name: Pipeline pack
description: Two pipeline templates and a JSON transform node that reshapes results without a model call. Pure JavaScript: no files, no network.

templates.title: Draft and critique
templates.description: One agent drafts, a second one critiques until the draft is approved.

templates.title: Collect, reshape and review
templates.description: An agent collects findings, the JSON transform keeps what matters, a reviewer checks it.

nodeTypes.title: JSON transform
nodeTypes.description: Merges the JSON results it receives, keeps some fields and renames them.

config.label: Keep fields
config.description: Comma-separated field names; empty keeps every field.

config.label: Wrap in field
config.description: Put the result under this field name; empty returns it as is.
